description: A standalone Python script demonstrating how to track keyboard focus and caret position using AT-SPI events, and control a GNOME magnifier via D-Bus to keep the focused object within the magnified view.

classes.name: RoiHandler
classes.description: Handles D-Bus calls related to zoom region of interest (ROI), including centering and nudging the ROI based on focus events.

methods.name: setRoiCenter
methods.description: Centers the ROI around specified x, y coordinates.

methods.name: setRoiCursorPush
methods.description: Adjusts the ROI to ensure the caret or control is visible.

methods.name: setRoiCenterErr
methods.description: Handles errors when setting ROI center.

methods.name: setRoiCursorPushErr
methods.description: Handles errors when nudging the ROI.

methods.name: magnifyAccessible
methods.description: Sets the magnification region to the accessible object or caret position.

methods.name: startTracking
methods.description: Begins listening to focus and caret events for magnification.

methods.name: stopTracking
methods.description: Stops listening to focus and caret events.

methods.name: onEnabledChanged
methods.description: Callback for changes in the magnifier enabled setting.

methods.name: _initMagDbus
methods.description: Initializes D-Bus connection to GNOME magnifier service.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point; initializes magnifier and event listeners.
